description_en: Creates an asynchronous image detection task that supports AIGC detection and tamper detection
description_zh: 创建异步图片检测任务，支持AIGC和篡改检测
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-image-detection-task --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --object-key deepsign/123456789/scan/abc12345.jpg --image-url https://example.com/id-card.jpg --detect-type tamper --use-tamper-small-model true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the image to be detected in OSS. When using ObjectKey, ensure that the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: object_key

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be detected. Only HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. Specify at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The detection type. Valid values: `aigc` (AIGC detection only) and `tamper` (credential tamper detection)
parameters.help_zh: 检测类型。取值：`aigc`（仅 AIGC 检测）、`tamper`（凭证篡改检测）
parameters.name: detect_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the small model for tamper detection. This parameter takes effect only when the tamper detection pipeline is used (DetectType is not specified or is set to tamper). If this parameter is not specified, the large model is used by default.

`true`: The small model is used for tamper detection. The large model report is not generated, and LlmResult is empty. However, basic algorithm results such as AIGC detection, AI post-processing, and PS localization are still returned.
`false`: The large model is used for tamper detection, and a comprehensive analysis report from the large model (LlmResult) is returned.
Not specified: The large model is used by default.
This parameter applies only to the tamper detection pipeline and does not affect AIGC detection (DetectType=aigc)
parameters.help_zh:
篡改检测是否使用小模型。仅在走篡改检测链路时生效（DetectType 不传或 tamper）。不传时默认使用大模型。

`true`：篡改检测使用小模型，不产出大模型报告，LlmResult 为空，但仍返回 AIGC/AI 后处理/PS 定位等基础算法结果。
`false`：篡改检测使用大模型，返回大模型综合分析报告（LlmResult）。
不传：默认使用大模型。
该参数仅作用于篡改检测链路，对 AIGC 检测（DetectType=aigc）无影响
parameters.name: use_tamper_small_model
